title: 地产公司总经理
description:
职位介绍
 1、充分理解行业、政策、市场、政府、用户，熟悉松果全链条业务，搭建区域经营体系，为业务在本区域的商业成功负责，商业成功包括不限于GMV、利润、市场占有率、政府满意度、用户健康度、企业品牌及其他可持续发展因素；
2、围绕业务目标，持续优化组织结构和运作，提升效率，降低成本，规范运作，确保组织发展满足业务需要；
3、关注人才成长与发展，持续提升组织活力和人才能力，打造业务过硬、开放进取、廉洁自律的区域铁军；
4、在满足市场需求的前提下，有效管理资产，确保资产运营效率最大化；
5、对市场、政府、用户需求有一定洞察力，对区域战略有判断、对区域发展方向有取舍；
6、持续经营客户，不断提升区域内政府、用户满意度。

岗位要求：
1、全日制本科及以上学历，深耕地产多项目总、区域总经验优先，年龄在43岁以下；
2、具备一定的长链条业务运营和政府事务的能力，熟悉ZF流程；
3、较强的体系化逻辑化思维能力，计划协调组织执行力，有在规模性企业逆转的成功案例；
4、敬业、皮实、要性强，有良好的输入、输出能力，认可企业文化价值观；
5、可接受较一定频率的出差。

title: 城市经理（美业）全国直营
company: 上海惟微美业生物科技有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 Skin79皮肤管理中心源于韩国首尔，专注肌肤年轻化25年，数字化新美业全国连锁品牌，全国35个城市已布局直营门店300余家，员工近2000名。

2023年全国新增门店300家，现诚聘城市经理一名（优秀店长可竞聘）

一、岗位要求:
1、形象好、气质佳、热爱美业、年龄28-40岁之间
2、美业督导、美业城市经理、运营总监经验3年以上，具有丰富的店务管理经验优先。
3、精通团队管理、客服管理、商品管理，熟悉店务的各项流程制定及执行。
4、有较强的团队管理能力和协调能力，能承受较大的工作强度和压力。
5、支持和指导各门店的业务，发现并支持门店的问题。

二、岗位职责:
1、全面主持城市管理工作，配合总部各项营销策略实施
2、执行总部下达的各项任务和业绩指标的达成
3、监督城市门店的商品损耗管理
4、妥善处理客户投诉和服务工作中所发生的各种矛盾
5、对于门店的人员有一定的选人、育人、留人标准
6、对于门店进行业务指导、协作发现门店的问题并指导解决
7、具备一定的市场敏锐度
三、薪酬福利：
1、底薪+提成，综合薪资2W-5W元/月；
2、福利：提供住宿、带薪年假、节假日礼品、团队聚餐、生日福利、每月组织团建活动、每月提供全面专业技能培训以及管理能力的培训、定期设立奖励政策。
 四、晋升空间：
城市经理→大区总监→运营部总监→副总
5、 五、作息时间：
早班：10:00-19:00 ；晚班13:00-22:00，月休4天，法定节假日排休。
公司注重人才培养和个人能力提升，愿意给每一位有人生追求的伙伴提供一个实现自身价值的平台，我们诚挚的欢迎您的加入！

title: 企服-销售总监/VP
company: 北京万联易达互联科技有限公司
description: 所属行业： 企业服务 / 工商财税 / 人力资源 / 法律知产 / 咨询培训 / 出海企服 / AI软件 / SaaS / 产业互联网 岗位职责 1. 制定并执行整体销售战略 根据公司战略和产品节奏，制定年度/季度销售目标、打法、区域布局和行业策略，对全企服集团营收结果负责。 2. 搭建并管理销售组织 从0到1或从1到10搭建全国销售团队，包括招聘、培训、分层、淘汰、激励和晋升机制，打造一支能打硬仗、结果导向的销售铁军。 3. 设计并优化销售体系 建立标准化的销售流程、销售漏斗、CRM管理规范、商机分级和预测机制，提升从线索到回款的整体转化效率。 4. 带队攻坚重点客户与重点市场 亲自参与大客户谈判、关键商机推进和标杆客户打造，指导团队完成客户开发、需求挖掘、方案沟通、报价谈判、签约回款的完整销售周期。 5. 推动跨部门协同 与市场、产品、交付、客户成功、财务法务等部门紧密配合，优化线索质量、产品方案、交付体验和回款效率，形成增长闭环。 6. 数据驱动销售运营 通过CRM、销售漏斗、转化率、客单价、回款周期等核心指标监控团队健康度，及时调整策略，确保业绩可预测、可复盘、可复制。 7. 建设销售文化与人才梯队 塑造“结果导向、勤奋皮实、不服输、赚钱欲望强”的团队文化，培养销售经理和后备骨干，降低核心人员流失风险。 8. 收集市场与竞争情报 持续跟踪市场动态、竞品策略和客户反馈，反向推动产品优化、定价策略和销售话术升级。 任职要求 • 全日制统招公办本科及以上学历，市场营销、工商管理、电子商务、法律、法学、财税、财务会计、人力资源等相关专业优先； • 8年以上B2B/企服销售经验，3年以上销售团队管理经验，有销售总监、销售负责人、区域负责人等管理岗位经历； • 有企业服务、工商财税、人力资源、法律知产、咨询培训、出海企服、AI软件、SaaS、产业互联网等行业背景优先； • 有从0到1搭建销售团队或从1到10规模化扩张的成功经验，带过10人以上销售团队； • 有明确的业绩结果：带团队完成过亿级或更高营收目标，有超额完成、扭亏为盈或新市场开拓经历者优先； • 精通销售漏斗管理、CRM运营、销售预测和绩效激励设计，能通过数据发现问题并推动改进； • 具备强抗压能力、强学习能力、清晰沟通表达和强结果导向，愿意深入一线，不脱离客户和战场； • 有较强的招聘、识人、用人、留人能力，能打造高战斗力、高凝聚力的销售组织； • 能接受一定频率的出差、陌拜陪访、电话复盘和一线作战。

title: Account Development Representative
description:
An Account Development Representative at MongoDB is the starting point for building a serious career in technology sales.  
 This role is the foundation of our sales organization. You will partner closely with Account Executives to identify new opportunities within strategic accounts, helping drive meaningful pipeline and long-term customer growth.   
 From day one, you will learn and apply structured sales frameworks including MEDDIC qualification, account mapping, multi-threading strategies, and value-based discovery. You will develop technical fluency across modern application architectures, cloud infrastructure, and database technologies, gaining real exposure to how complex software solutions are positioned and sold.  ADRs at MongoDB do more than generate meetings. They help shape early deal strategy, apply MEDDIC principles to qualify real business problems, and stay engaged through the scoping phase to maintain strong deal momentum  
 We invest heavily in structured onboarding, ongoing enablement, and consistent 1:1 coaching. Our ADR team is one of the primary talent pipelines into Account Executive and other revenue roles across MongoDB, with clear, performance-based progression paths. 
 Hybrid Model 
 We believe skill development accelerates when teams collaborate in person. This is a hybrid role based in Shanghai, China. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Own outbound prospecting within a defined set of strategic accounts, working closely with your aligned Account Executives and Sales stakeholders. 
 Research organizations to uncover new initiatives and opportunities where MongoDB can add value. 
 Execute thoughtful outbound outreach across phone, email, and social channels to generate qualified pipeline. 
 Lead structured discovery conversations to understand business priorities and technical environments. 
 Apply MEDDIC qualification principles to ensure high-quality opportunities before advancing them. 
 Stay engaged through the early stages of the sales cycle, contributing to strong handoffs and clean deal progression. 
 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and sales engagement tools. 
 Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity targets. 
 
 We’re looking for someone with 
 
 Has a track record of setting goals and exceeding them in competitive or performance-driven environments. 
 Communicates clearly and confidently in Mandarin and English (fluent). 
 Takes ownership of outcomes and follows through on commitments. 
 Can manage a high level of outbound activity while maintaining quality and attention to detail. 
 Is coachable and actively applies feedback. 
 Learns technical concepts quickly and is curious about how businesses use technology. 
 Is serious about building a long-term career in technology sales. 
 Is comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders and handling rejection professionally. 
 
 Things We Love 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 Formal training or certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger) or technical disciplines. 
 Prior experience in sales, business development, or other quota-carrying/customer-facing roles. 
 Exposure to databases, cloud infrastructure, open-source technologies, or modern application development. 
 Experience using Salesforce and sales engagement platforms such as Outreach or Sales Navigator. 
 
 Why You Should Apply 
 
 Great earning potential. 
 Welcoming and inclusive workplace  Meet MongoDB’s Employee Affinity Groups!  
 Continuous career development. 
 Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message. 
 Sales Bootcamp 
 Buddy program cross-departmentally 
 
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. Mongo

title: AIDC项目经理
company: 武汉有树科技有限公司
description: 【招聘背景】 我们正在寻找一位深耕智算基础设施领域的项目经理，负责AIDC（人工智能数据中心）从园区选址、土建机电施工、算力设备部署到最终验收移交的全生命周期管理。您将是连接设计院、总包商、设备供应商、GPU厂商与内部技术团队的“超级枢纽”，确保高功率、高密度的智算中心项目按预算、按时、高质量交付。 【岗位职责】 1、项目全生命周期统筹管理：作为项目总负责人，统筹管理AIDC项目从前期规划、设计、采购、施工、测试、验收到最终交付的全过程。制定详细的项目总体计划，拆解关键里程碑（如土建封顶、机电进场、设备联调、消防验收），建立动态管控机制，确保项目目标达成。统筹设计、采购、施工、测试、验收五大条线，应用BIM+数字孪生平台实现项目全流程可视可控。 2、技术落地与基础设施整合：主导AIDC基础设施的规划与执行，整合土木、机电（MEP）、电力、散热（含液冷）、服务器及网络等关键设施。把控国产/国际软硬件（芯片、GPU服务器、存储、算力调度平台等）的选型适配、集成调试及兼容性验证，解决交付过程中的技术瓶颈。 熟悉高功率GPU集群（如NVIDIA H100/SXM、华为昇腾等）的部署流程，统筹IB/RoCE高速网络、液冷系统的架构整合与调试。 3、资源协调与多方干系人管理：协调内部团队（供应链、采购、机房基建、GPU集群技术、商务销售、财务）与外部多方（机房业主、集成商、设备厂商、监理、设计院、客户）。管理设计顾问、EPC统包商、设备供应商及电信业者（高压电力、CDU液冷、GPU机架等），督导合约履约、施工品质及交付质量。作为客户对接第一责任人，定期同步项目进展，维护良好客户关系。 4、风险、成本与质量管控：识别AIDC项目全周期各类风险（工期、成本、合规、供应链等），建立风险清单，制定应对策略及应急预案。管控项目全要素成本，编制与管控项目预算，优化资源配置，确保项目在预算范围内完成。严格把控项目交付质量，落实质量检查标准，确保项目符合国家相关规范及客户需求。 5、验收、文档与建运衔接：组织内部预验收、客户正式验收，完成验收报告签署。牵头整理项目交付全流程文档（实施方案、测试报告、硬件资产台账、拓扑图纸、运维操作手册），形成标准化交付资料。负责将建设完成的数据中心平稳移交给后续的NOC运维团队。 【任职要求】 1、硬性条件：本科及以上学历，工程管理、机电、暖通、电气、计算机、通信工程等相关专业优先。具有5年以上数据中心/智算中心/AIDC建设项目管理经验；至少独立承担过 2个单体规模≥1000机柜或≥10MW 的数据中心项目，且担任项目经理/项目副经理角色。 2、专业技能：熟悉IDC/AIDC基建全流程：选址、土建、机电、弱电、消防、验收。了解电力、暖通（含液冷）、弱电等核心技术指标及规范。 3、熟悉智算技术生态，了解主流芯片、GPU服务器、存储设备、算力调度平台的特性与集成方案。 4、具备优秀的项目预算编制、成本控制和变更管理能力。 5、熟练使用项目管理工具，可独立编制WBS、项目计划、风险台账、项目周报。 通用能力： 1、具备极强的跨部门、跨公司沟通协调与资源整合能力，能够管理多方集成商、供应商。 2、具备较强的风险意识、质量意识，做事严谨负责、执行力强。 【加分项】 1、持有PMP、一级建造师（机电/通信与广电） 等证书。 2、持有CDCP/CDCS（数据中心专业认证）或LEED绿建筑认证。 3、完整主导过百万卡级推理/训练算力项目或MW（百万瓦）级以上大型AI数据中心建置项目。 4、熟悉运营商招标、政府采购及政府审计流程，有售前技术方案编制、招投标答辩、合同谈判经验。 5、具备流利的英文听说读写能力，能独立处理海外简报与对谈。

title: 高级数据分析工程师-双休六险一金包吃住
description: 岗位职责： 1.负责 SAP 系统至数据仓库的数据集成链路建设，精通 ETL 数据流开发与优化，熟练使用 SLT、Data Services 等工具进行实时/批量数据抽取、转换与加载； 2.负责各类数据调度任务的设计、开发与运维，建立完善的任务依赖体系与告警机制，持续开展资源监控与性能优化，保障数据及时、准确、稳定交付； 3.基于 SAP HANA 进行数据仓库建模，深入理解数仓分层理念（ODS/DWD/DWS/ADS），主导分层模型设计与物理表落地，持续优化模型性能与数据口径管理； 4.使用 FineReport / FineBI 完成报表与自助分析看板的开发、发布与维护，支撑财务、供应链等业务域的数据可视化需求； 5.参与财务模块（总账、应收应付、费用、成本等）的数据开发与分析，理解财务业务流程与核算逻辑，构建财务分析指标体系； 6.负责数据质量校验、元数据管理与数据问题排查，配合业务方完成需求分析、口径对齐与数据验证； 7.编写数据开发相关技术文档，参与数据平台规范与标准的制定与落地。 任职要求：1.本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息管理等相关专业，5 年以上数据开发相关工作经验； 2.精通 ETL 数据流开发与优化，熟练掌握 SLT、Data Services（DS）等工具，具备各类数据调度的开发经验，熟悉资源监控与性能调优； 3.熟悉数据仓库分层理念，具备扎实的 SAP HANA 建模经验（列存表、视图、计算视图、SQLScript 存储过程等）； 4.精通 FineReport / FineBI 工具，具备复杂报表开发与自助分析平台建设经验； 5.有财务模块数据开发与分析经验，熟悉 SAP 财务（FI/CO）相关表结构与业务逻辑者优先； 6.熟练掌握 SQL，具备大型数据仓库项目的完整实施经验，有 SAP ERP（如 S/4HANA、ECC）周边数据开发经验者优先； 7.具备良好的沟通协作能力与业务理解能力，能独立对接业务部门完成需求转化为数据方案；工作严谨细致，责任心强，有较强的数据敏感度与问题排查能力。

title: 海外广告投放
company: 河南繁花科技有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 岗位职责
1.负责海外投放策略与执行。根据产品阶段制定市场、渠道和预算测试方案，独立完成Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads的账户搭建、广告上线与日常优化。
2.推动素材测试与本地化。分析目标用户、竞品广告及使用场景，提出素材脚本和制作需求，协同设计、视频及内容人员测试买点，提高点击、激活和付费转化。
3.对获客效率和回收负责。跟踪新增、CPI／CAC、付费率、收入、ROAS、LTV及回收周期，定位成本和转化问题，提出放量、调整或暂停建议。
4完善归因与数据分析。协同研发完成渠道事件、归因及收入数据核验，区分自然量与付费量，按国家、渠道、素材和获客批次分析效果。
5.协同产品优化商业化。推动商店页面、落地页、注册引导、会员页及订阅流程优化，提高用户付费和长期回收。
6.沉淀可复用的投放方法。建立测试记录、素材库及复盘机制，为后续海外产品复制有效经验。
岗位要求
1.熟悉 Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads 的投放机制，能够独立开展账户搭建、事件配置、定向、出价及效果优化；其中至少两个渠道有深入操盘经验，能说明第三个渠道的实际使用经历。
2.有从小规模测试到持续投放的完整案例，能够说明投放预算、目标市场、个人操作、关键问题和优化结果，可提供脱敏案例。
3.具备素材判断与测试能力，能从用户需求出发提炼买点、撰写脚本需求，并根据数据推动素材迭代。
4.具备经营分析能力，能够结合获客成本、付费率、客单价、续费和回收周期判断投放价值，理解不同渠道的归因差异。
5.熟悉常用归因与分析工具，例如AppsFlyer、Adjust、Firebase、GA4中的一种或多种，并有相关事件配置或数据核验经验。
6.英文可作为工作语言，能够完成广告文案分析、竞品研究和渠道沟通。
优先：
● 有海外App或软件产品投放经验，工具类、效率类、影像创作类、订阅制产品经验优先。
● 有ASA经验、海外产品早期增长经验，或独立推动产品转化优化的经历者优先。

description: 岗位职责： 一、特种气体系统安全管理（核心职责） 1. 负责厂区特种气体、高纯气体供气系统日常巡检、稳压监控、安全检测、台账管理； 2. 落实特种气体安全操作规程、供气接收、切换、钢瓶储运安全管理； 3. 负责气体管路、报警系统、GMS 气体监控系统日常运维、异常排查、故障快速处置； 4. 对接气体供应商，落实供气保障，保障产线工艺气源稳定。 二、公辅动力系统运维管理 1. 压缩空气系统：空压机、干燥机、过滤器、储气罐日常运维、压差管控、除油除水管理，保障洁净车间用气标准； 2. 纯水系统：纯水机、树脂、RO 膜、电阻率监控、水质定期检测、耗材更换、水质达标管控，满足生产超纯水要求； 3. 生产废水系统：生产废水、工艺废气、废气处理系统、排放日常监管； 4. 配合环保局、第三方检测、环保审核、专项检查，确保全年合规零违规。 任职要求： 1. 本科及以上学历，具有 3-5 年以上光电或半导体行业大宗气体系统运营及维护经验； 2. 熟悉氮气（N₂）、氧气（O₂）、氩气（Ar）、氢气（H₂）等大宗气体供应系统； 3. 熟悉气体储罐、汽化器、压力调节系统、阀门及气体输送管道； 4. 熟悉气体压力、流量、纯度及供应稳定性的监控与管理； 5. 具备设备预防性维护（PM）及故障维修（CM）经验； 6. 熟悉气体监控系统（GMS）及气体泄漏检测系统（GDS）； 7. 具备气体系统安全管理、风险评估及紧急事故处理经验。

title: Customer Success Manager (Scaled)
description:
As a Customer Success Manager, you are the trusted advisor helping a high volume of customers navigate their journey on MongoDB using proactive, scalable engagement strategies initiated by health signals and journey milestones. You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a diverse portfolio of thousands of expanding MongoDB customers, acting as a strategic connector between your customers and providing the right help at the right time to achieve their unique business goals. You’ll drive healthy adoption, customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy at scale. You will innovate, navigate ambiguity, and build scalable programs and processes to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most. 
 We are looking for Mandarin speaking candidates who are based in Hong Kong for our hybrid working model. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Advisory 
 
 Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 Drive ongoing consumption and value realization through a mix of 1:1 and 1:many engagements (e.g., targeted campaigns, webinars, office hours), using data-driven insights to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across a broad customer portfolio and recommending optimal solutions, features, and adoption paths to achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 
 Account & Portfolio Management 
 
 Own elements of the account plan that drive customer maturity and lifetime value, retention, and revenue realization. Proactively manage thousands of customers across various stages of maturity by leveraging 1-to-many methodologies and tools to balance individual customer impact with scalable outcomes that maximize long-term success 
 Track and report progress against key business outcomes, forecast revenue retention and realization to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact, collaborating with presales teams to support growth 
 Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI-driven tools to streamline daily workflows, improve productivity, and optimize customer success outcomes 
 
 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy 
 
 Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization 
 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes 
 
 What You Will Bring 
 
 Relevant Experience: 5 to 7+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product 
 Accountability: 3+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization across a portfolio of accounts. Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools 
 Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to influence technical and business outcomes 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or equ

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, AI Gateway
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
 Netskope AI Gateway helps global enterprises securely adopt, scale, and govern Generative AI. We are seeking a  Staff / Sr. Staff Software Engineer  to architect, build, and scale the core systems powering our AI Gateway product and its supporting microservices across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid environments. 
 Based in Taiwan, you will be a technical anchor for our core development team. This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on building highly scalable backend systems, with real ownership: the systems assigned to you are yours to design, build, and defend — depth matters more than volume. You will operate at the intersection of deep distributed systems engineering and cutting-edge AI technology. We are looking for an engineering leader who leverages AI to accelerate their workflows, but possesses the rigorous, production-grade coding skills required to architect complex systems, ensure enterprise-grade security, and validate AI-generated code. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Core Backend Development:  Architect, build, and scale our core AI Gateway solutions, backend services, and high-throughput APIs. You will focus on writing highly concurrent, robust, and maintainable software, primarily in  Golang . 
  Command AI-Driven Engineering:  Integrate AI and agent-based tooling (e.g., Copilots, code generators) into your daily development workflow to accelerate scaffolding, boilerplate, and hypothesis generation.  Crucially, you will act as the gatekeeper:  you must possess the deep software engineering expertise to audit AI-generated code, ensure architectural soundness, and reject code that introduces technical debt or security flaws. 
  Design for Scale and Resilience:  Build distributed systems capable of handling immense data payloads, streaming LLM responses (Server-Sent Events), and complex proxy routing without introducing unacceptable latency. 
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner directly with global engineering, AI researchers, and product teams. Translate ambitious AI features into scalable, maintainable software architectures. Raise system design considerations before a single line of feature code is written. 
  Push Engineering Excellence:  Drive the technical culture of the Taiwan team through architectural reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Advocate for best practices in modern, AI-augmented software development, security, and scalable system design. 
  Deep Systems Debugging:  While not primarily an incident support role, you will be the ultimate escalation point for the hardest systemic development roadblocks. Trace complex issues across asynchronous microservice

title: 复合材料工艺工程师（气压熔渗方向）
company: 合肥阿基米德电子科技有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 一、 岗位职责 
1、核心工艺开发与优化 
负责复合材料气压熔渗工艺的方案设计、参数调试与持续优化。主导熔渗温度、压力、保温时间、真空度、模具设计等关键工艺窗口的摸索与固化，解决熔渗不全、金刚石氧化、界面反应过度或不足等核心痛点。针对不同粒度及不同表面处理的金刚石颗粒，开发适配的熔渗工艺路线。 
2、界面反应与性能调控 
深入研究熔渗过程中界面的润湿性及反应机理，通过调整合金成分或优化金刚石预处理工艺，降低界面热阻，提升复合材料热导率。监控并分析金刚石石墨化、开裂等缺陷，提出改进方案。 
3、新产品导入与量产转化 
负责新产品从实验室研发到中试及量产的全过程工艺转化。编制并维护标准作业指导书（SOP）、工艺参数表（PFMEA）、控制计划等工艺文件。 
4、设备维护与产线建设 
参与气压熔渗炉及配套设备的选型、安装调试与验收。制定设备维护保养计划，确保设备稼动率与工艺稳定性。 
5、质量控制与失效分析 
针对量产过程中的异常（如气孔、夹杂、变形），运用金相分析、SEM/EDS、热导率测试等手段进行失效分析，推动闭环改善。 
6、技术沉淀
撰写专利、技术报告及论文。 
二、 任职要求 
1. 教育背景 
学历：本科及以上学历（特别优秀者可放宽）。 
专业：材料科学与工程、金属材料、粉末冶金、复合材料、冶金工程等相关专业。 
2. 工作经验 
必备经验：具备3年以上金属基复合材料或陶瓷基复合材料研发/工艺经验。 
核心经验：有气压熔渗、真空压力浸渍、无压熔渗等工艺实操经验者优先； 
镀层经验加分：熟悉金刚石表面金属化（如蒸发镀膜、盐浴镀膜、磁控溅射膜）工艺者优先。 
3. 专业知识与技能 
理论基础：精通金刚石特性及制备工艺、界面润湿理论、高温扩散反应机理；
设备操作：熟练操作真空烧结炉、气氛保护炉、抛光设备、热导率测试仪（如激光闪射法LFA）等。 
分析能力：能熟练使用SEM、EDS、XRD等分析手段进行界面表征。 
图纸与软件：能看懂机械图纸，熟练使用AutoCAD 或SolidWorks 进行简单的工装夹具设计；熟练使用JMP/Minitab进行DOE实验设计及数据分析。

title: 域控硬件项目经理
company: 黑芝麻智能科技有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 工作内容
负责域控硬件的项目管理，涵盖硬件需求分析、方案设计、原理图/PCB、样件试制、测试验证、小批量生产及量产导入；确保硬件产品按节点、高质量交付，满足车规级可靠性及客户量产要求。

1、硬件全流程交付管理
-主导域控硬件从需求定义、架构设计、器件选型、原理图/PCB设计、样件试制（A/B/C样）、DV/PV测试、PPAP到SOP及量产爬坡的全过程。
-制定硬件开发主计划（含关键路径、里程碑、缓冲），跟踪各阶段进展，识别并推动偏差纠正。
-组织硬件设计评审（原理图、PCB布局、热仿真、SI/PI分析等），确保设计质量。
2、跨团队协同与供应商管理
-协调内部硬件设计、结构、EDA、热设计、EMC、测试、采购、生产等部门，保障硬件开发与软件、系统集成的高效协同。
-管理外部供应商（PCB厂、贴片厂、连接器、被动器件等），确保物料选型、样品交付、产能保障符合项目需求。
-推动关键器件（SoC、MCU、PMIC、存储等）的选型、认证及替代方案评估。
3、测试验证与质量管控
-制定硬件测试策略（功能测试、电源/信号测试、环境可靠性、EMC、寿命等），监督测试执行及问题闭环。
-参与DV/PV测试计划制定，分析测试失败项根因，推动设计整改与回归验证。
-确保硬件交付符合IATF 16949、AEC-Q100/Q200等车规标准。
4、成本与风险管控
-负责硬件BOM成本管控，推动器件替代、设计优化以达成目标成本。
-识别硬件开发中的技术风险（芯片供应、信号完整性、散热等）及进度风险，制定预案并动态跟踪。
-对硬件变更（ECR/ECN）进行影响评估，组织变更评审及执行。
5、量产导入与售后支持
-主导硬件从工程样件到量产的转化（包括产线测试、烧录、组装工艺评审）。
-支持生产部门解决量产中的硬件问题，参与良率提升及持续改进。
-协助售后团队分析现场硬件故障，推动设计根因修复及经验固化。

任职要求
1、本科及以上学历，电子工程、通信工程、自动化、计算机等相关专业。
2、3年以上汽车电子硬件开发或硬件项目管理经验，有域控制器（座舱/智驾）或复杂嵌入式硬件产品交付管理经验。
3、完整负责过至少一个硬件产品从设计到SOP的全流程交付，熟悉硬件开发全流程。
4、具备硬件设计背景（如原理图设计、PCB Layout、器件选型等实际经验）者优先。
5、熟悉硬件测试项目（电源、时钟、接口、SI/PI、环境、EMC）及常用仪器（示波器、频谱仪、万用表等）。
6、熟悉IATF 16949、APQP、PPAP、DFMEA等质量工具。
7、优秀的跨部门沟通与协调能力，能拉通硬件、软件、结构、测试、生产等团队；强烈的结果导向与责任心，对硬件交付成败有Owner意识；良好的问题分析与解决能力，能快速定位硬件技术瓶颈并推动决策。

title: Senior Developer（OTR）
description:
Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard. 
 For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. You will leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems and proactively assess your team’s health, code quality and nonfunctional requirements. 
 
 Job responsibilities 
 
 
 You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns 
 You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible 
 You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients 
 You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices 
 You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way. 
 You will apply the latest technology thinking from our  Technology Radar  to solve client problems 
 You will efficiently utilize DevSecOps tools and practices to build and deploy software, advocating devops culture and shifting security left in development

 You have experience using one or more development languages (Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript.) with experience in Object-Oriented programming 
 You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable with Object-Oriented programming 
 You are comfortable with Agile methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum and/or Kanban

title: Software Developer
description:
Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard. 
 At Thoughtworks, we believe in going above and beyond the standard and are committed to delivering best-in-class solutions that exceed our clients' expectations. Our standard engineering and delivery practices reflect our commitment to quality, and our team is always looking to innovate and improve. 
 
 Job responsibilities 
 
 
 You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns 
 You will use continuous delivery practices as needed to deliver high-quality software and value to end customers 
 You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients 
 You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way 
 You will partner with other technologists from cross-functional teams advocating and demonstrating DevOps culture 
 You will take ownership and accountability beyond individual deliverables, always pushing the envelope in order to deliver awesome results for our clients 
 You will learn, digest and subsequently apply the latest technology thinking from our  Technology Radar  to solve client problems 
 
 
 Job qualifications 
 
 Technical Skills 
 
 
 You have two or more years* of experience 
 You have experience using one or more development languages (Java, Kotlin, React, TypeScript etc.) with experience in Object-Oriented programming 
 You can write clean, high-quality code in a variety of languages and are also able to spot (and improve) bad code 
 You are familiar with Agile, Lean and/or Continuous Delivery 
 You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools 
 Bonus points if you have knowledge of cloud technology such as AWS, Docker or Kubernetes 
 
 
 Professional Skills 
 
 
 You thrive in a collaborative, non-hierarchical environment that values transparency, openness, feedback and change 
 You have a passion for learning and sharing knowledge as well as a desire to create the right solutions for business problems 
 You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives 
 You're fluent in English, with the ability to handle full English conversations and job interviews seamlessly.（Must have) 
 
 
 
  *For candidates with less than two years of experience,    please visit the Grads and career changers page on our careers site.   
 
 
 Other things to know 
 
 Learning & Development 
 
 There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys. 
 
 
 Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment 
 
 At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.  Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.  We are committed to fairness and responsible AI.

 Launch and optimize campaigns by applying best practices across measurement, creative strategy, testing, and performance targets.

 Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and communicate campaign performance, product updates, and growth opportunities effectively.

 Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and independently lead routine commercial discussions, escalating complex negotiations when appropriate. 
 Share learnings and best practices across the regional Business Development team. 
 
  Basic Qualifications  
 
 3–5 years of professional experience in account management, business development, sales, performance marketing, media buying, digital strategy, or a related field. 
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. 
 Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world.   What we are looking for:  
 As an Android BSP Engineer, you will be responsible for the kernel and driver level system development, which includes building, troubleshooting, and writing automated tests for the Android system on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android app teams. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up. 
  What you’ll do:  
 
 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams. 
 Design, implement, and maintain drivers and Android services that operate efficiently in a constrained environment and meet the reliability and security requirements of the industry. 
 Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers and communication, and power and performance management and optimization. 
 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status).

 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed. 
 Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance. 
 
  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

title: Quantitative Developer
description:

We specialise in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. Our Founding Partners, including Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Shanghai, Sydney, Singapore and London. 
  What you’ll do as a Quantitative Developer on the Quant Trading & Research team at Akuna:  
 Akuna’s Quantitative Trading and Research team creates trading strategies scientifically by combining its quantitative expertise with sophisticated understanding of derivatives and financial markets. The team is looking to add Quantitative Developers who will work alongside researchers, traders, and system engineers to develop software that incorporates vast amounts of data to drive sophisticated strategies, capturing market opportunities before our competition. The successful candidate will have a strong programming background to produce trading solutions and high-performance production code. In this role you will: 
 
 Design and develop production code of trading strategies: pricing models, execution logic and performance optimization 
 Develop and improve data and research pipeline 
 Advance existing codebase and propose new solutions and improvements 
 
  Requirements for this role:  
 
 3+ years of experience developing performant, scalable applications in modern C++ 
 BS/MS/PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent 
 Experience using data to drive decision-making 
 Desire and ability to learn the intricacies of financial markets 
  Willing to prepare and take English technical interviews  
 
  Qualities that make great candidates:  
 
 Solid understanding of multi-threaded/multi-core programming paradigms 
 Experience with high frequency trading system 
 Deeper understanding of any of the following fields: Linear Algebra, Numerical Methods, Statistics, Optimization, Signal Processing, Computer Architecture, Machine Learning, Heterogeneous/High Performance computing 
 The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role 
 Passion towards financial markets and trading

title: 蛋白技术工程师 (MJ000241)
description:
职位介绍
 工作内容：
1.主导真核膜蛋白的高效制备工作，针对不同类型膜蛋白特性，制定并优化制备方案，熟练运用两性共聚物纯化、Nanodisc（纳米圆盘）、VLP（病毒样颗粒）、去垢剂增溶等多种技术手段，解决膜蛋白表达量低、稳定性差、纯化难度大等关键技术问题。
2.负责shRNA（小干扰RNA）基因沉默技术的方案设计与实施，开展目标基因敲低/敲降细胞系的构建、筛选与鉴定工作，包括shRNA序列设计、载体构建、细胞转染/感染、稳定细胞株筛选、敲降效率验证等全流程工作，确保构建的细胞系满足实验或生产需求。
3.持续跟踪国内外真核蛋白表达、膜蛋白制备及基因沉默领域的前沿技术动态，结合实际工作需求，对现有实验方法、技术流程进行优化升级，提升实验效率、产物质量及稳定性；推动新技术、新方法在团队内的应用与落地。
4.针对实验过程中出现的蛋白表达异常、纯化失败、细胞系构建不稳定、敲降效率不达标等问题，进行系统分析，制定有效的解决方案并实施验证，保障项目顺利推进。
5.协助团队负责人推进相关研发项目，与跨部门团队进行高效协作；为团队成员提供膜蛋白制备、shRNA细胞系构建等相关技术指导与培训，分享技术经验。
6.负责实验记录、数据归档及实验报告的撰写，确保研发过程可追溯、数据真实可靠，参与项目阶段性总结与汇报工作。
负责细胞培养（贴壁与悬浮），包括CHO-K1、HEK293、Sf9等细胞的复苏、传代、冻存。

岗位要求：
1.硕士研究生及以上学历，分子生物学、细胞生物学、生物技术、生物工程、结构生物学、生物化学等相关专业背景。
2. 熟练掌握真核蛋白表达系统（如CHO、HEK293、f9等细胞系）的操作，具备丰富的膜蛋白表达与制备经验，至少熟练掌握两性共聚物纯化、Nanodisc、VLP、去垢剂增溶中的2种及以上膜蛋白制备技术，并能独立解决相关技术难题。有哺乳平台两性共聚物纯化或nanodisc相关经验者优先。
3.熟练掌握蛋白纯化相关技术（如亲和层析、离子交换层析、凝胶过滤层析等）及设备操作，具备蛋白纯度分析、活性检测的相关经验；熟悉细胞培养、细胞转染、细胞活力检测等细胞生物学核心实验技能。
4.具备良好的科研思维和实验设计能力，能独立开展系统性实验并分析数据。
5.英语水平良好，能熟练检索、阅读并理解英文文献。
6.具备良好的沟通能力、团队协作精神和自主学习能力

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
 Netskope's Data Platform is the backbone behind every security insight our customers see, ingesting and processing security telemetry from a global edge network at massive scale. We own the full data path — from collection at the edge, through stream processing and enrichment, to the query, routing, and delivery systems that put that data in customers' hands. On top of that foundation we build the analytics, reporting, and export capabilities that our customers rely on to understand and act on their security posture. We are now investing in an AI-native future, building a semantic layer that makes our data machine-interpretable and agentic experiences that let customers ask questions of their data in natural language. 
  What you’ll work on  
 
 Partner with architects to design and evolve the systems that carry telemetry from global edge ingestion through processing, query, and customer delivery, with a focus on scale, durability & latency. 
 Raise the bar on observability, SLOs, deployment safety, and production resilience of the platform that others build on top of - not just a single service. 
 Build the AI-native semantic layer that’s the foundation to make our data machine-interpretable, and the agentic experiences on top of it that let customers ask questions in natural language.  
 Lead cross-team initiatives, shaping architecture through design reviews, and mentoring engineers, with the freedom to adopt modern & open source technologies. 
 
  Required skills and experience  
 
 10+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant time operating at Staff-level (or equivalent) technical scope. 
 Strong coding ability in one or more of Go, Java, Python, or C++, with a track record of shipping production systems, not just designing them. 
 Experience designing for reliability at scale — observability, SLOs, incident response, and safe deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes). 
 Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: influencing architecture decisions, driving design decisions, and aligning teams around a direction. 
 Experience building high-throughput ingestion and data services over modern RPC and wire protocols — HTTP/2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers — including schema design and evolution.  
 Experience with high-throughput data pipelines — data streaming & batch ingestion, processing, and storage using columnar data formats such as Parquet  
 Excellent written and verbal communication, and the flexibility to collaborate across time zones with globally distributed teams.  
 Ability to ramp up quickly into unfamiliar codebases and domains as priorities evo

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Linux, PC, IoT
description:
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. The Commercial Engineering Quality Assurance (QA) team works with all the engineering teams in Canonical, OEM and ODM customers, to bring Ubuntu directly to millions of users by delivering certified Ubuntu laptop, desktop, IoT and other computing devices. 
 As a Software QA engineer, you will join the team responsible for our strategy for quality coordination and testing. You will be a quality expert with extensive experience establishing quality processes from the ground up. You will understand the tools and techniques used to introduce new products, and will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. 
 Location: This is an office-based role in Beijing. 
  As a Software Quality Assurance Engineer you will:  
 
 Plan, create and manage the overall Quality Planning strategy and document 
 Improve our automated test capability with design and code contributions 
 Perform automated and manual testing of Ubuntu Desktop, Server and Core on varies latest hardware. 
 Suggest solutions to identified product problems 
 Collaborate with the Project team to ensure consistent project execution 
 Identify quality assurance process bottleneck and suggest improvements 
 Oversee continuous improvement projects  
 Collect quality data 
 Establish proactive measures to improve the quality and reliability of the Ubuntu platform 
 Prepare time estimates and schedule for testing activities 
 Identify, isolate, and document bugs clearly and concisely in the bugs database 
 Work with development teams across multiple projects to build efficient, effective automated testing 
 Communicate effectively with colleagues in a variety of time zones around the world 
 Triage test reports and customer bugs 
 
  The successful Software Quality Assurance Engineer will have :  
 
 Experience with the Linux desktop, and related technologies. Ubuntu experience would be a plus 
 Solid grasp of commercial Software QA practices and ideas on how to integrate them into Linux Community standards 
 Experience with common scripting languages, including Shell script, Python or JavaScript 
 Comfortable with online communication and collaboration such as mailing lists, Mattermost, wiki 
 Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills 
 Strong written and spoken communication skills in English 
 Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team 
 Ability to pick up new technologies and achieve high effectiveness quickly 
 
  What Canonical Offers:  
 
 Learning and development 
 Annual compensation review 
 Recognition rewards 
 Annual leave 
 Priority Pass for travel 
 Annual health check 
 
  About Canonical  
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. 
 Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

 Graduating between August 2027 and December 2028 with a Degree in Finance, Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related disciplines

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.  
 The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
 2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent through collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns.  Collaborate extensively with global recruiting team to create successful strategies for marketing Jump and building our brand. 
 Other duties as assigned or needed. 
 
  
 Skills You'll Need: 
  
 
 Strong organizational skills.

 A hardworking and upbeat personality.

 Reliable and predictable availability.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.   We are seeking skilled engineers to build scalable distributed systems and integrate agentic AI and conversational analytics. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will lead the architecture, data modeling, and core infrastructure powering our next-generation AI and analytics platforms. 
  Role and Responsibilities  
 
 Architect, develop, and deploy global-scale distributed platforms and pipelines for massive data ingestion, transformation, and analytical reporting. 
 Design and refine backend infrastructure supporting Agentic AI workflows, autonomous systems, and conversational analytics with natural language interfaces. 
 Partner with application teams to define data strategies and durable conceptual models spanning OLTP/OLAP and generative AI architectures (e.g., RAG). 
 Evaluate data integration challenges and deliver optimized architectural solutions for complex business requirements. 
 Research emerging AI techniques and advanced machine learning methodologies to continuously enhance data design patterns. 
 Provide technical leadership and mentorship across the project lifecycle, focusing on efficient data modeling, prompt engineering, and high-performance data access services. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 At least 8 years of hands-on experience in architecture, design, or development of enterprise data solutions, applications, and integrations. 
 Proven experience designing and deploying Agentic AI systems and working with AI application frameworks. 
 Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly. 
 Bachelor or Master degree in STEM majors. 
 Strong algorithms, data structures, and coding background with either Java, Python, or Scala programming experience (Python highly preferred for AI/ML ecosystem compatibility). 
 Exceptional proficiency in SQL, alongside familiarity with semantic search and Natural Language to SQL paradigms. 
 Experience building products using at least 1 of each of the following distributed technologies:  - Relational Stores  (i.e. Postgres, MySQL, or Oracle)  - Columnar, NoSQL, or Vector Stores  (i.e. Starrocks, Clickhouse, BigQuery, Pinecone or pgvector)  - Distributed Processing Engines  (i.e. Apache Spark, Apache Flink)  - Distributed Queues  (i.e. Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, or GCP PubSub) 
 Experience with software engineering standard methodologies (e.g., unit testing, code reviews, design documents). 
 Experience working with GCP, Azure, AWS, or similar cloud platform technologies.

title: Experienced MFT Quantitative Researcher
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an Experienced Quantitative Researcher who specializes in mid-frequency research to join us in our Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm where quantitative research, technology, and an entrepreneurial culture are at the heart of our business. 
 In this role, you will identify and develop new trading opportunities by leveraging Flow Traders’ advanced research capabilities and quantitative trading platform. 
  What will you do  
 
 Research and develop intraday to few-day quantitative alpha signals, and systematic trading strategies 
 Apply modern computational techniques, including machine learning and high-performance computing, to develop scalable and effective quantitative trading models 
 Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and traders to translate models into production-ready strategies 
 Contribute to research methodology, tooling, and best practices across the global quantitative research team 
 
  What you need to succeed  
  
 
 A master’s degree in a STEM discipline, computer science, or a related quantitative field; a PhD is preferred 
 3+ years of experience in quantitative trading 
 A proven track record of profitable mid-frequency trading strategies, operating on intraday to few-day horizons, in APAC equities and/or futures markets 
 Strong grounding in time-series modeling, signal research, and portfolio construction across short holding periods 
 Understanding of market microstructure and the construction of mid-frequency signals from order book and tick data 
 Demonstrated success translating modern quantitative methods into profitable trading strategies 
 Excellent communication skills and experience managing stakeholders across trading and technology 
 A strategic vision for the role of machine learning and AI in the future of systematic trading 
 
   
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Senior Software Engineer, C++ (Market Data)
description:
Flow Traders Hong Kong is looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to lead the next-generation architecture of the market data and execution platforms that power our fully systematic trading. We don't treat market data as plumbing - for us it's a source of alpha, where feed handling, order book construction, and a deep understanding of exchange microstructure are themselves a competitive edge. We're looking for a senior individual contributor who has lived this philosophy in a proprietary or systematic trading environment and can squeeze every nanosecond out of the path from wire to strategy. 
 As a senior individual contributor, you'll be working on the Core Platform that underpins quantitative research, pricing, strategy development, and execution across hundreds of venues. You'll work in a tight, iterative loop with quants and technical traders, applying deep expertise in modern C++, OS internals, CPU and memory architecture, lock-free concurrency, and low-latency networking to push our systems toward state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and observability. 
 What you will do: 
 
 Design and implement high‑performance components for market data ingestion, normalization, and distribution, as well as its usage for order execution and strategy infrastructure. 
 Develop tools and frameworks that enable quants and technical traders to build, tune, and deploy data‑driven systematic pricing and trading strategies. 
 Own the full lifecycle of your components in a fast‑paced, iterative environment: deploy, monitor, profile, and optimize your code in production. 
 Work closely with focus group engineers, quants, and technical traders to refine requirements, collect feedback, and iterate on the platform's design and implementation. 
 
 What you need to succeed: 
 
 BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 5+ years of post‑graduation professional C++ software development experience. 
 Experience building low‑latency market data ingestion, order execution, and algorithmic trading systems (proprietary trading industry preferred). 
 Strong knowledge in one or more APAC markets.  
 Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures. 
 Experience in parallel, asynchronous, and multithreaded programming. 
 Demonstrated ability to write clean, reliable, and highly scalable C++ code. 
 Interest in extracting maximum performance from available hardware and software (CPU caches, memory layout, networking, etc.). 
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical colleagues.

description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale. 
 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support). 
 The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

 Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security for Ubuntu Linux kernels

 Significant programming experience in Python
